visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). There is no index.html in this directory. The visual target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3.
note: Homes grain fix 2026-08-14. Rhythm: THREE of the six patterns, no two adjacent alike, chrome exempt. Order is Breadcrumb, Field of the cut houses as a V3Carousel photo rail (count is a caption, never an Instrument hero), Drawing of the week's cuts, Sheet, Quiet, Footer. The empty window substitutes a Quiet for the Field and is still three patterns. Every figure comes from ONE getPriceDrops({ limit: 48, days: 7 }) call. Absent is not zero: an empty resilient-cache fallback is opted out of ISR with noStore(), and Dataset / updated / count figures are omitted rather than published as 0. Drop math is previous list price to current list price. Field rows sort by lastDropPct descending. HideAwareListingGrid is a declared deletion: hidden-home subtraction stays on /search. SITE-70: photographs open via shadcn-carousel -> V3Carousel; ItemList JSON-LD lists the cut homes. SITE-108: the rail cell is a CUT, not a listing tile -- the percent is the card's headline (no chip over a photograph whose brightness we do not control), a meter under it draws this cut against the deepest cut on the page with a notch at the page's middle cut, and the card also carries what the seller gave up in dollars and how many days ago the ask fell (getPriceDrops lastDropAmount / daysSinceLastChange). Price, prior ask, address and beds/baths/sqft all stay. The deepest cut leads at a wider slide (the plate is wider, never taller). prev/next are shadcn's OWN -left-12 / -right-12 flanking pair -- V3Carousel no longer repositions them and .pd-cuts-stage is the inline room they need. ONE median serves the card notches, the drawing's hairline, the deck sentence and the Dataset.

sectionOrder: PriceDropsOpening -- the H1, the count of homes that cut price, and the answer in text (middle cut and deepest cut)
V3Field #cuts -- V3Carousel rail of photographed cut houses (percent + cut meter, dollars off, price, prior ask, address, beds/baths/sqft, days since the cut)

V3SourceLine -- the trace and the stamp under the set
PriceDropAlertsSheet -- the ask: tell me when a home cuts price
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow's and Redfin's price-cut filters on a page a search engine can actually rank. Their reductions live behind a filter state with no indexable URL; this is a standing page for 'price reductions bend oregon' and 'price drops central oregon' that publishes the cut homes themselves, each one a door, with the source trace and the refresh stamp under the set. The answer -- how many homes cut price and by how much -- is in text, not only in the list.

tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts price-drops --builder claude-opus-5 — the judge chain fell to the claude CLI: this cloud sandbox has no cursor-agent and no grok CLI, so both grok-4.6 links were missing. Three scorings of one capture in one call, median. Separate from the builder.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs default, scale 1, palette-quantized, against the production build on http://127.0.0.1:3401

tasteReview.beats: Redfin/Zillow price-reduced grids — the shared-scale dot strip (48 cuts, smallest to deepest) shows the whole batch's magnitude in a way neither grid attempts. WSJ Markets 'biggest movers' still beats this page on magnitude-before-address, labeled points and hover detail.

defects.finding: The opening is a row of uniform equal-width cards — photo, badge, price, address — indistinguishable from a portal’s price-reduced search results; nothing about the composition reads as an editorial field of 264 markdowns, just a listing rail.

The control is a strip of same-size cards with overlay chevrons at the far edges, not the shadcn Carousel's single-slide-with-Previous/Next composition, and no open/drag state was captured to prove the embla interaction exists.

The 48 dots carry no visible per-point label, address or value — only the two endpoint captions ('5.6% off' / '13.0% off') convey information, so the chart reads as a decorative scatter rather than a drawing a reader can query point by point.
The dark badge chip sits on varied photo backgrounds with inconsistent contrast card to card, and there is no visible focus ring or pressed state despite the whole card being a tap target.

tasteReview.verdict: Competent, on-brand listing rail with one real idea — a shared-scale dot strip ordering all 48 cuts smallest to deepest — but demoMatch is FALSE: the carousel reads as a photo strip of uniform cards with corner arrows rather than the shadcn Carousel demo object, and the dot strip has no per-point labels or evident hover state. Listing facts (price, prior price, percent off, address, beds/baths/sqft) are present and sourced, so information did not regress. NOT Tip Ready; node stays in_progress.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: evaluatorModel differs (prior mark grok-4.6, this mark claude-sonnet-5 — this sandbox has neither the grok CLI nor cursor-agent, so both grok links were missing) and rubricVersion differs (prior v1-2026-09-10, this v1-2026-09-12). Two of the three identity keys changed, so 59 is NOT comparable to the prior 60 and is neither a rise nor a drop. The next pass on THIS instrument must rise by the floor over 59.
